label: Black
description: Black lining is the natural choice for formal evening wear — tuxedos, dinner suits, and black-tie jackets — where it creates a seamlessly dark interior that reinforces the jacket's dressiest register. Against lighter fabrics such as ivory or midnight blue it provides a crisp, high-contrast flash when the jacket moves, and for dark wool suits it produces a unified, solemn depth that suits both City formality and evening elegance. Black linings are also practical, as they are more resistant to visible soiling and fading than pale or patterned alternatives.
